title: TranscriptSearchQuery
description: A search request over the transcript substrate — events, notes, files, PRs, outcomes, and memory episodes (binder ch04 'Transcript search and blackboard'; ch07 M6 gate: search 'how did we deploy X' and get cited results). BUDGET RULE (ADR-0097, normative): every query carries an explicit retrieval budget, and the M6 gate 'memory retrieval never exceeds configured budget' is checked against it — the paired TranscriptSearchResult reports actual usage against this budget so the invariant is auditable per query, not asserted globally. MODE RULE: default mode is hybrid (lexical + semantic with rank fusion); lexical-only is a degraded mode a caller must opt into explicitly, never a silent fallback. This is a query in the CQRS sense: it displays, it never decides — no search result may authorize a command (ADR-0095 'commands decide; queries display; events record'). Redaction is respected: hits are filtered by the caller's visibility ceiling; redacted payloads never leak through search snippets.

issuedBy.description: Accountability join: who is searching. An agent's own searches appear in its transcript as memory_retrieval events.

queryText.description: Natural-language or lexical query, e.g. 'how did we deploy the email ingress worker'.

mode.description: hybrid = lexical + dense with rank fusion (the default posture); semantic/lexical are explicit narrowings.

scope.description: Corpus narrowing. Empty scope = the whole harbor the caller can see.

eventKinds.description: Restrict to transcript event kinds (open strings per transcript-event.schema.json).

sources.description: Which corpora to search (ch04: 'across past agent transcripts, notes, tool calls, diffs, files, PRs, and outcomes').

budget.description: The configured retrieval budget this query must never exceed (M6 gate). The result echoes it back with actual usage.

maxContextTokens.description: Hard cap on the token weight of returned snippets/excerpts — the number that protects the caller's context window (ch04: 'retrieved memories should stay under a fixed context budget').

retrievalHints.description: Optional tuning; the engine may ignore hints but must never exceed budget because of them.

fusion.description: Rank-fusion method for hybrid mode; rrf = reciprocal rank fusion.

rerank.description: Apply a cross-encoder rerank before returning top results.

visibilityCeiling.description: Highest visibility class the caller may see (per transcript-event visibility). Redacted classes are never searchable content.
